fourth_document: Sealed source and labels unchanged; never loaded by development runner.
candidates: deterministic table frame + closed fact-name selection + existing validators + explicit reviewer edits
production typed-slot assisted draft + same validators and edit rubric
edit_unit: One semantic correction at one independently meaningful site. Unit addition, fact/entity rebinding, each missing applicability bound, and requirement replacement count separately. Wholesale replacement of the main connective/quantifier structure is rewrite. No edit inferred merely from string inequality.

eligibility.numeric_denominator: Freeze author-reviewed numeric target-obligation IDs before evaluating. Include unsupported clauses; exclude bare article IDs, zone identifiers, page numbers and quantities only in unrelated context. Report all 46 coverage separately.
eligibility.low_burden: Fully source-correct connected rule reached with zero or one semantic edit; missing-context cases cannot be counted as low burden.
eligibility.independent_review: Ten blinded rows returned by teammate; report exact agreement and disagreements. No independent-review claim until sheet returned.
eligibility.binding_and_scope: No approvable candidate with wrong ownership, omitted applicability, missing unit or unsupported exception. No model approval bypass.

choice_order: Discard candidates with any source-wrong/incomplete approvable draft, or missing required measurements.
Require >=50% of frozen numeric development obligations to reach intended rule with <=1 edit.
Among eligible candidates, choose lower median semantic edit burden; then fewer rewrites; then fewer measured tokens per finished clause.
If no candidate qualifies, report no pipeline selected and leave fourth document sealed. Do not relax criteria after seeing results.

held_out_run.precondition: Selected candidate and code/configuration commit recorded before opening any fourth-document source/labels for inference.
held_out_run.transport_failure: Report API_UNAVAILABLE separately; cached retry of the identical failed request is allowed, never a changed prompt/model after seeing a semantic response.
held_out_run.grading: Same edit rubric, whole source meaning, source-wrong approvable count and denominators. All labels remain author-written without independent review unless returned sheet covers them.
